shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on grey stone
tall vertical rectangular field of decoration
roughly bilateral/symmetrical arrangement about a vertical axis
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented grey stone surfaces bearing shallow relief organised symmetrically about a central vertical axis, and both include prominent disc/rosette-like circular forms paired with sweeping curved bands. Beyond that the correspondence collapses: A is a three-dimensional worked block whose worn, abstract curvilinear motifs are placed as a few isolated, non-repeating signs, whereas B is a flat slab carrying a crisp, regularly repeating vegetal scroll with paired palmette-like fans marching up the panel.
